title: Characterization of majority functions
statement: For each $n\in\mathbb N$, a function $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ is a majority function if, for every input $x$, whenever the sum of the coordinates of $x$ is nonzero, $f(x)$ equals $1$ if that sum is positive and $-1$ if it is negative.
hypotheses_covered: For every input with nonzero coordinate sum, the function agrees with the threshold sign of that sum
